subject: Onsite brand greenscreen + livestream rights — SOW confirmation
messages:
From: Sarah Cole <events@horizonsummit.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Max Turner <max.turner@horizonsummit.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -0400
Subject: Horizon Summit — Sponsor SOW + livestream/greenscreen questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for confirming Redwood as a Gold sponsor for Horizon Summit (Sept 28–30). Attached is the updated SOW and floorplan we referenced on the call — I’ve flagged a couple of open items we need sign-off on before sending the final DocuSign:

- Greenscreen booth: can we confirm Redwood will provide a branded greenscreen backdrop and whether the logo should be on the left or right third? The production team needs an answer by Aug 12 for set build.
- Livestream rights: the standard package includes co-branded livestream lower-third. You previously asked about pre-roll and recorded session rights — we can offer a 30s pre-roll and on-demand hosting for an additional fee (I’ve noted the rate in the SOW).
- Camera blocking / demo-camera exclusivity: exhibitor camera blocking around the main stage is an add-on and requires procurement sign-off from your side if you want the dedicated camera window during the keynote/lunch demos.

Please see attachments: [Attachment: HorizonSOW_v2.pdf (pdf)], [Attachment: exhibit_floorplan_v7.png (png)], [Attachment: livestream_spec_v1.docx (docx)].

If you can confirm the greenscreen placement and whether you’ll take the pre-roll & camera-blocking add-ons, I’ll route the final SOW to Legal and send a DocuSign.

Thanks,
Sarah
Events Director
Horizon Summit
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cole <events@horizonsummit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Horizon Summit — Sponsor SOW + livestream/greenscreen questions

Hi Sarah — thanks for the SOW and the clear callouts. A few quick confirmations/questions from our side:

- Greenscreen: Redwood will supply a 10x8 branded greenscreen. Prefer logo on the right third of the backdrop so it’s visible on camera when demos face the main aisle. Please confirm that the HVAC/rigging team can clear the right flank for the backdrop (we’ll coordinate load-in times).
- Pre-roll & on-demand: we’re interested in the 30s pre-roll and on-demand hosting, but want the pre-roll to be run in the first two livestream sessions only (keynote day 1 + product deep-dive). Can you confirm inventory and whether those two placements are guaranteed?
- Camera blocking: we have a live demo that requires an uninterrupted demo camera window during the keynote demo (approx 12:30–12:50 on Sept 29). We understand this is an add-on — please confirm cost and whether exclusivity covers the 20-minute demo window only or a 1-hour buffer.
- Recorded rights: we need rights to reuse on-demand recordings in our marketing channels (website and email) for 12 months; please confirm there are no additional clearance steps.

We’ll need the final SOW in DocuSign by Aug 14 to get procurement to sign before your build deadline. Attaching our brand asset request (final logo files, color profile) as soon as we confirm placement.

Also looping in Marissa (ops) for AV/load-in, Aditya (marketing) for pre-roll creative, and Soojin (events ops) for exhibit logistics.

Best,
Kimberly
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Cole <events@horizonsummit.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Max Turner <max.turner@horizonsummit.com>, Legal Team <legal@horizonsummit.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 11:35:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Horizon Summit — Sponsor SOW + livestream/greenscreen questions

Hi Kimberly — quick answers inline: 

- Greenscreen placement: Right third is fine; production confirms rigging clearance as long as load-in window is respected (you’ll be assigned a 3-hour install block on Sept 27).
- Pre-roll & inventory: We can guarantee the two pre-roll placements you requested (keynote day 1 & product deep-dive). Pre-roll will run immediately before the session starts and is capped at 30s.
- Camera blocking: The add-on covers a 1-hour window around the demo (30 minutes before / 30 minutes after). Cost for the exclusivity add-on is listed in section 4.3 of the redlined SOW. Legal has flagged one minor change to the recording rights clause; I attached a redline for that exact sentence.
- Recorded rights: We grant Redwood non-exclusive rights to host and use recordings for 12 months for marketing purposes, subject to the one minor legal edit in the redline. No additional clearance steps from our side beyond the signed SOW.

I’ve attached a redlined SOW (HorizonSOW_v2_redline.pdf) that incorporates the camera-blocking fee and the small legal tweak. If you’re comfortable with the language, we’ll push this through DocuSign tonight.

[Attachment: HorizonSOW_v2_redline.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks — ping me if you want to take the camera block for the single 1-hour window or limit to the 20-minute demo. Once we have your PSW (purchase sign-off), I’ll send the DocuSign link and the finalized booth load-in schedule.

Best,
Sarah
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Horizon Summit — Sponsor SOW + livestream/greenscreen questions

Kimberly / team — confirmed next steps from Redwood: 

1) Approve the redlined SOW as sent by Horizon (we accept the legal edit). Marissa to sign internal procurement docs today; we will accept the camera-blocking add-on for the 1-hour window (12:00–13:00 Sept 29).
2) Aditya to coordinate two pre-roll creatives (30s) — targets: keynote day 1 and product deep-dive. Deliverables deadline: Aug 20 (final masters to Sarah).
3) Soojin to confirm install window with Horizon and confirm rigging clearance for right-third greenscreen. Load-in: Sept 27, 10:00–13:00.
4) Kimberly to provide speaker bio + headshot by Aug 12 for the session page and livestream lower-third.
5) Marissa to confirm PO and route to procurement; once PO is issued, Sarah to send DocuSign and we’ll sign within 48 hours.

I’m attaching a quick checklist for internal ops and the asset drop folder link.

Attachments: [Attachment: sponsor_activation_checklist.xlsx (xls)], [Attachment: exhibit_floorplan_v7.png (png)]

If there are no objections I’ll notify Horizon to expect the signed SOW and PO by Aug 11–12.

-Marissa
Senior Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference
